_comment: Dungeons are hidden until a clue reveals them. Rooms are fought back to back with life carried over. Treasure is one card from the dungeon's list, a chance at an artifact, and gold. All names are card names fetched at runtime.

attrition.label: Attrition
attrition.text: Your life carries from room to room. Theirs does not.

gloom.label: Gloom
gloom.text: Torches gutter here. Your opening hands are six cards.

warded.label: Warded
warded.text: Every room is sealed. Each guardian begins with a Wall in play.

miasma.label: Miasma
miasma.text: The air is poison. You lose 1 life at the start of each of your turns.

hoard.label: Hoard
hoard.text: The guardians feed on what they guard. Each has 4 extra life.

dungeons.name: Sunken Chapel
dungeons.intro: A chapel of the old Court, half swallowed by the plain. Its bells still ring at dusk.

dungeons.name: Drowned Archive
dungeons.intro: The Tidewatch flooded its own library to keep its secrets. The secrets learned to swim.

dungeons.name: Barrow of the Keepers
dungeons.intro: Where the Keepers bury what they cannot use yet. Nothing here is finished dying.

dungeons.name: Ashfall Foundry
dungeons.intro: A Forge Company furnace abandoned mid-pour. The slag remembers how to burn.

dungeons.name: Rootbound Hollow
dungeons.intro: The Circle sealed this hollow before the war. The roots have had thirty years to think about it.
